<size=50>この地には、<br>三つの大国が割拠していた</size>:
In this land,
the Three Great Nations carved out their own domains.
<size=50>鋼の騎士団を擁する「ミレスガルド王国」</size>: <size=50>The Kingdom of Milesgard, with its Steel Knights.</size>
<size=50>魔術の理を究めんとする「ペルディオン皇国」</size>: <size=50>The Perdion Empire, seeking to master the Arcane Arts.</size>
<size=50>富を求め、富を愛する「エルドラーナ共和国」</size>: <size=50>The Eldorana Republic, seeking wealth and loving it.</size>
<size=50>三国は互いの譲れぬ正義を掲げ、<br>長く戦乱の時代を刻んでい:
The Three Nations, each holding aloft a justice none would surrender,
had long sustained the Age of War.
<size=50>一人の英雄の出現が、束の間の平穏をもたらしたが、</size>: <size=50>The coming of a single Hero brought a fleeting peace,</size>
<size=50>それも今は昔……</size>: <size=50>but that, too, was now a thing of the past...</size>
<size=50>英雄は去り<br>大陸は再び戦火の渦に呑み込まれようとしていた:
The Hero departed,
and the continent was about to be swallowed once more into the maelstrom of war...
<size=50>だが、人類同士が争う時代は、<br>突如として終わりを告げる<:
But the age in which Humanity warred against itself
came to an abrupt end.
<size=50>大地に穿たれた、巨大な『大穴』の出現</size>: <size=50>The Abyss appeared—a colossal hole gouged into the earth.</size>
<size=50>対岸は、水平線の彼方のように遠く霞み<br>底には、永遠の闇と:
The opposite shore was hazy and distant, as though beyond the horizon,
and in its depths dwelt eternal darkness and despair...
<size=50>後に、人々は知る</size>: <size=50>In time, people would come to know</size>
<size=50>その無垢な探究心が、<br>悲劇の引き金となることを……</s:
that innocent curiosity would become
the trigger of tragedy...
